content.text: Oe, BAWIPA, na ram hah na lungyouk teh,
Jakop catoun san lah a hrawi e naw hah
bout na bankhai toe.
Na taminaw e payonnae hah na ngaithoum teh,
a yonnae pueng na ramuk pouh toe.
Na lungkhueknae pueng hai na dam sak teh,
na lungkâannae pueng hai na kamlang takhai toe.
Oe ka rungngangnae Cathut,
bout na roung sak haw,
ka lathueng na lungkhueknae teh na takhoe pouh haw.
Kaimouh koe na lung pou a khuek han maw.
Na lungkhueknae teh se pueng dawk na caksak han na maw.
Nang dawk na taminaw a konawm thai awh nahan,
bout na pâhlaw mahoeh toung na maw.
BAWIPA, na lungmanae na hmawt sak nateh,
na rungngangnae na poe haw.
BAWIPA Cathut ni a dei hane lawk hah ka tarawi han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, a taminaw hoi
a tamikathoungnaw koevah,
lungmawngnae lawk hah a dei han.
Hatei, pathunae koe lah teh kamlang awh hanh.
Maimae ram dawk bawilennae ao thai nahan,
a rungngangnae teh ama ka taketnaw hoi a hnai tangngak.
Lungmanae hoi lawkkatang a kâhmo teh,
lannae hoi lungmawngnae a kâpahnuep.
Lawkkatang teh talai dawk hoi a dâwn teh,
lannae ni kalvan hoi a khet.
Bokheiyah, BAWIPA ni hnokahawi a poe.
Maimae ram ni a tâcokhai e a pawhik teh a pung han.
A hmalah lannae a cei vaiteh,
khokhnuk teh lamthung lah a sak han.
